chunks: And for others among them who have not joined them yet. He is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'others' mentioned in the verse who have not yet joined?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the 'Ahl al-Bayt' or the faithful who were yet to join the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) during his lifetime, or more broadly to future generations of believers who will follow the path of the Imams. The attribution of 'Al-Aziz' (The Mighty) and 'Al-Hakim' (The Wise) underscores God's sovereign ability to bring about the ultimate victory of the true believers despite their current absence or minority status.
